spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25, the first day of the window (caretaker holdover for a few hours). The whole 제5공화국 cabinet handed in resignations on 1988-02-24 as the 전두환 term ended at midnight, the resignations were accepted on the morning of the 25th, and the 노태우 cabinet received its 임명장 later that day. Before the inauguration the government stated that the incumbent ministers would attend it as 국무위원 and that the new ministers' authority began with the 11:40 임명장 ceremony (중앙일보 1988-02-22). The end is therefore 1988-02-25, a same-day handover with 나웅배. ko.wikipedia gives 1988-02-24. The farewell ceremony at the ministry was held on 1988-02-26 together with 나웅배's 취임식. Appointed 1987-05-26 in the 전두환 reshuffle after the 박종철 case, from 재무부장관, and received the 임명장 the same afternoon (동아일보 1987-05-26). Held the 부총리 title ex officio (정부조직법 제17조③, 법률 제3854호 version, 부총리 1인 and 경제기획원장관이 겸임). No ko.wikipedia article (the 경제기획원 table links a red page) and no Wikidata item was found (searches for 정인용 and 鄭寅用, wikidata_extra.json), so birth date, gender and English name are left empty. Hanja from 조선일보 1988-02-25 ('鄭寅用부총리'). 중앙일보 1987-05-26 gives his age as 52. The start follows the 임명장 day (medium, see 이승윤). ko.wikipedia gives 1994-10-04. Last 경제기획원장관. The office was abolished when 법률 제4831호 took effect on 1994-12-23, and the end follows the office's last day in offices_1988.json. The act was in fact promulgated and took effect at about 2 p.m. on 1994-12-23 (국민일보 1994-12-23, a special 관보 issue), so he was legally 경제기획원장관 until that afternoon, the same situation as 임창열 in 1998 in finance.verified.json. On 1994-12-23 the President named him 부총리 겸 재정경제원장관 in the 19개 부처 reshuffle (동아일보 1994-12-24 still calls him 경제기획원장관 that day), and he received the new 임명장 and held the 재정경제원 취임식 on 1994-12-24. That 재정경제원 spell belongs to the finance lineage (reorg_continuation and reappointed_on_reorg should be set there). Held the 부총리 title ex officio (정부조직법 제17조③ as amended by 법률 제4268호 of 1990-12-27, 부총리 2인 with the 경제기획원장관 first in the acting order). issues.desc: Date convention for 1988-1994. Before 2001 there is no gazette, and for four of the seven appointments the reshuffle was announced one or two days before the 임명장 was handed over (1990-03-17 and 03-19, 1991-02-18 and 02-19, 1993-12-21 and 12-22, 1994-10-04 and 10-05). This file takes the 임명장 day as the start, because the government said before the 1988 inauguration that a new minister's authority begins with the 임명장 (중앙일보 1988-02-22), and pm.verified.json starts 고건 on his 임명장 day. Official pages of other ministries agree for the same reshuffles. The moj, mohw, msit, 총무처, 내무부 and motir pages start every 1990 appointee on 1990-03-19, and the 총무처 and 내무부 pages start the 1993-12 appointees on 1993-12-22 (read 2026-09-26, roster/sources/epb/ext88/crosscheck_1990.json, snapshots in xpages/). For the end this file takes the day the outgoing minister was relieved, meaning the day the replacement was announced after the resignations had been handed in. That was also the day of his 이임식 in 1990, 1991 and 1993, and it follows the main roster's rule of using the dated acceptance in the news (justice.verified.json issues). Most of those ministry pages instead print the predecessor's end as the day before the successor's start (1990-03-18), and ko.wikipedia uses the announcement day for both dates. The other ext88 lineages hit the same reshuffles, so the assembler should check that they use one rule.

정인용 (전두환 appointee) is in the window only for the morning of 1988-02-25. His resignation was accepted that morning and 나웅배 received the 임명장 later the same day. He is included as a caretaker holdover with end 1988-02-25, following the same-day handover convention of the main roster. ko.wikipedia ends his term on 1988-02-24. If the project decides that a minister whose resignation was accepted on inauguration morning is out of scope, drop this spell.

홍재형's end is 1994-12-22, the last day of 경제기획원 in offices_1988.json. The amending act was promulgated and took effect at about 2 p.m. on 1994-12-23 (국민일보 1994-12-23), so strictly he held the office on the morning of 1994-12-23 too. This follows the 임창열 precedent in finance.verified.json. On 1994-12-23 he was still called 경제기획원장관 when he was named 부총리 겸 재정경제원장관 (동아일보 1994-12-24), and he received the 재정경제원 임명장 on 1994-12-24. The finance ext88 file should start his 재정경제원 spell with reorg_continuation true and reappointed_on_reorg true, and decide whether that spell starts on 1994-12-23 or 1994-12-24.

Corrections against ko.wikipedia ('경제기획원', revid 40684353). 최각규 left on 1993-02-26, not 1993-02-24. 이경식 started on 1993-02-26, not 1993-02-25 (the 김영삼 cabinet was named and received the 임명장 on 1993-02-26). Wikipedia's other day-level dates are the announcement days (see the first issue).
One-day vacancy on 1990-03-18 (a Sunday) between 조순 and 이승윤, with no acting head named in the sources read. It comes from the date convention in the first issue.

No tier 1 record exists for these dates. The moef 역대 장관 page (tier 2) gives months only, and all eight months agree with the dates used here. Day-level dates rest on 대통령기록관 일정, 대한민국사연표 and day-of news from the Naver News Library (OCR) and BigKinds (typed text from different papers). The OCR passages quoted here read cleanly and were not compared with the page images. Every start and end date has day-of stories from at least two different papers, and for every date but one they come from both archives.
정인용 has no ko.wikipedia article and no Wikidata item, so birth date, gender and English name are empty. 홍재형 has no English label on Wikidata.
No from_main records. 경제기획원 was abolished on 1994-12-22, so no spell of this office continues past 1998-02-24 and nothing was copied from the existing verified files.

Cross-lineage date rule. For the same reshuffles this file ends the outgoing minister on the day he was relieved (1990-03-17, 1991-02-18, 1993-12-21, 1994-10-04) and starts the successor on the 임명장 day, while finance.ext88.json ends the outgoing 재무부장관 on the successor's 임명장 day (이규성 1990-03-19, 홍재형 1994-10-05). 한겨레 1990-03-18 (BigKinds 01101001.19900318000000206) reports that 조순 and 이규성 both held their 이임식 on the morning of 1990-03-17. The verifier kept this file's values, which follow the main roster's rule of the dated acceptance in the news (justice.verified.json), and flags the difference for the assembler. Resume check 2026-09-26, verified ext88 files only. For the 1990-03 reshuffle 7 lineages end the outgoing minister on 1990-03-19 and 1 (this one) on 1990-03-17. For the 1993-12 reshuffle 4 lineages end on 1993-12-21 and 3 on 1993-12-22. pm.ext88.verified.json follows this file's rule (황인성 ends 1993-12-16 on the acceptance, 이회창 starts 1993-12-17 with the 임명장). The per-lineage rows are in verification.resume_2. One rule should be applied at assembly.

Acting record added. 정재석 was 국무총리 직무대행 from the acceptance of 이회창's resignation (1994-04-22, 17:00) until 이영덕 received his 임명장 (1994-04-30, 08:30). It duplicates pm.ext88.json on purpose, as the main roster does for the 재정경제부 and 기획재정부 ministers.
